purpose: Expose the current VCP rule (original exits ∩ breakout low ≥ prior session low) on 2023-01-01 through the frozen ledger end. Not a clean holdout. Training 2016-2022 stays the development sample.
validation: entry 2023-01-01..ledger end; completed exits in that window only; open or post-window exits listed, not mixed into the mean
suitable_if: Validation avg_pnl stays positive and profit_factor does not collapse versus training. Does not by itself authorize live trading.
